observations: wire_size encodes str as UTF-8 and returns byte length; bytes input is passed through to len unchanged.

For non-str, non-bytes input (e.g. int, None, list), body.encode is not called and len(body) is evaluated, which raises TypeError for int/None but succeeds for list/tuple, returning element count rather than wire bytes.
Probe p1 wire_size('한글') returns 6 (two 3-byte UTF-8 chars), consistent with the contract.
Probe p2 wire_size(b'AB') returns 2, consistent with the contract.
Probe p3 wire_size('') returns 0, consistent with the contract.
No static findings were supplied; the only changed line is the return expression on line 2.
